_comment: Role template for a SHELL-ENABLED agent (tools: shell in hive.yaml).
ONLY use this with `runtime: docker`. In the tmux runtime a shell escapes the room:
path matching cannot secure `bash -c`, verified — see docs/SECURITY.md. The container
is what makes Bash safe here; the kernel enforces the boundary, and this file's hook
is defence in depth that gives the agent a useful message instead of a bare EACCES.
Still denied: Task/Agent (recursion), the network tools, and the scheduling/messaging
tools. Egress is separately restricted to an allowlist (docs/SECURITY.md), so even a
shell cannot reach the internet beyond api.anthropic.com.
Substitutions: {{HIVE_BIN}} = hive's bin dir on the AGENT's filesystem.
Generated by `hive provision` — do not hand-edit inside a room.
